Hello everyone. Decided to do some contributing here for a change.

Steam is having a free weekend on two nautical games. You don't have to be a sailing enthusiast to enjoy these titles.

The Ship: Murder Party is a multiplayer game about deception, stalking and murder. You're a passenger on a luxury cruise ship that is owned by a rich madman called Mr.X. You're given a quarry that you must kill while avoiding your own hunter at the same time. Weapons vary from candlesticks to thompson machine guns.

Guns aren't always the best choice since you get more money using a weapon no one has used during that game. Using a weapon brings its value down to 100$ after a round. You also can't go around blasting people away everywhere. You need to avoid cameras, guards and other passengers. Getting caught trying to kill someone with a knitting needle will get you thrown in jail. Your hunter also gets informed that you're in the big house and they will probably wait for you outside the prison.

The most played gametype is hunt. When the first person is killed, the timer starts ticking down. After the timer reaches zero, the round ends and everyone gets assigned a new quarry. This is a good gametype if you don't like waiting after dying and are still learning the game.

Elimination keeps going until there is only one person left. When you kill your quarry, you get assigned the quarry they had. In the end there will only be two players left fighting in a deadly cat&mouse. You can also chain together kills but you've got to be careful to kill the people in right order. Killing innocents gives you a penalty.

I'd like to point out that the game is no longer updated. They will be releasing a HD version of the game in early access in February 2016. That will probably kill this version altogether. You also can't use the server browser in the game for some reason. You need to access the server browser from the steam icon.

Sunless Sea is a top down game with roguelike elements. You play as a captain of a small vessel, trying to fulfill your goal. You get to pick the goal yourself. The game features permanent death but there is an easy mode available that disables that. You can also buy a will to transfer your equipment to the next captain you play as, but that costs money.

The game is difficult and running away from trouble is often the better option than fighting a losing battle. Swarms of bats, other ships and seamonsters are roaming the zee (the sea is called the zee). You visit different ports, complete quests and meet interesting characters throughout the game. The atmosphere is pretty grim most of the time and there is a lot of text to go through. This game is for those that enjoy good world building, stories and challenging gameplay.
